subject: Payment allocation going forward
text:
Hi,

Starting with the December statement, could you please split our payments: 60% to the account you have on file, and 40% to our paper supplier, Delta Paper Mills, since they're now being paid directly from receipts under our supply agreement. Delta's ACH info is on the attached.

Thanks for accommodating this.

Brightline Accounting
